      "1: \"\"\"Synthetic ASR cache/consent contracts; never import the runner or a model.",

      "18: RUNNER_SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"whisper_runner.py\"",

      "20: ",
      "21: def blocked(*args, **kwargs):",
      "22:     raise AssertionError(\"unexpected runtime or download call\")",
      "23: ",
      "24: ",
      "25: def runner_functions(source):",
      "26:     functions = {",
      "27:         \"normalize_model\", \"_model_cache_root\", \"_model_repo_root\",",
      "28:         \"_checked_model_snapshot\", \"_cached_model_snapshot\", \"is_model_downloaded\",",

      "33:         \"MODEL_LARGE_V3_TURBO\", \"_MODELS\", \"_MODEL_REPOSITORIES\", \"_ASR_CACHE_FILES\",",
      "34:     }",
      "35:     tree = ast.parse(Path(source).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8-sig\"))",

      "37:         isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in functions",
      "38:     ) or (",
      "39:         isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(",
      "40:             isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in constants for target in node.targets)",
      "41:     )]",
      "42:     assert functions == {node.name for node in nodes if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)}",
      "43:     scope = {",
      "44:         \"Path\": Path, \"re\": re, \"_WHISPERX_AVAILABLE\": True,",
      "45:         \"_download_model_snapshot\": blocked, \"_runtime_device\": lambda: \"cpu\",",
      "46:         \"_compute_type\": lambda device: \"int8\", \"_now_iso\": lambda: \"synthetic-time\",",

      "48:     future = ast.ImportFrom(module=\"__future__\", names=[ast.alias(name=\"annotations\")], level=0)",

      "50:     exec(compile(module, str(source), \"exec\"), scope)",
      "51:     return scope",

      "54: class ProductGuardContracts(unittest.TestCase):",
      "55:     def setUp(self):",
      "56:         self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"uoink-asset-guard-synthetic-\")",
      "57:         self.addCleanup(self.directory.cleanup)",
      "58:         self.root = Path(self.directory.name).resolve()",

      "141: ",

    "numbered_text": [
      "1: \"\"\"C-02 (CRIT-2) -- reliability detection on faster-whisper (MIT), no",

      "16: \"\"\"",

      "44: ",

      "46: def test_no_whisper_timestamped_reference():",

      "70: ",
      "71: def test_clustering_over_injected_faster_whisper_stream():",
      "72:     # Two low-confidence runs separated by a confident word, plus a homophone",
